notes: High-frequency kanji drawn from the existing JLPT N5–N1 decks, ordered by approximate frequency (KANJIDIC2 newspaper-corpus consensus for the top tiers, then by JLPT level for the long tail). Ultra-basic single-reading N5 kanji are filtered out (numerals, basic body parts, simple time words) — kept exceptions are kanji English speakers commonly trip over: transitive/intransitive pairs, multi-reading items, position/time nuance, counters. Each card carries a frequency_rank field; ranks are approximate. Dropped: 一七万三九二五人八六円分十千口四女子年手日時月男百目足
